answer.reason: Pisgah is the place where Balaam built altars and where Moses was shown the promised land, events that go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was where Balaam built seven altars and offered sacrifices at Balak's request
clauses.quote: to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars

clauses.english: was where Moses went up and the LORD showed him all the land he would not enter
clauses.quote: Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah

doubts: Ashdothpisgah and the springs of Pisgah (DEU 3:17, DEU 4:49, JOS 12:3, JOS 13:20) only mark boundaries and place names, so they were left out.
NUM 23:14 has Balak bringing Balaam; the verse's 'he' is Balak, implied from context.
